column8: The IsTypeBlob and IsTypeChar rows execute through exhaustive source type-code partitions and preserve the false Int24 cases.
All Duration Datetime Timestamp Date NewDate and invalid-byte temporal assertions execute through FieldTypeCode::is_type_temporal.
Bit with binary/non-binary collations and Blob binary/non-binary rows execute through FieldType::is_binary_string.
Bit and Blob rows preserve the source non-binary string partition through FieldType::is_character_string.
Datetime Date Timestamp and invalid-byte rows execute through FieldTypeCode::is_temporal_with_date.
Blob and Char prefixable rows plus the invalid-byte false row execute through FieldTypeCode::is_type_prefixable.
Datetime Duration Timestamp and invalid-byte rows execute through FieldTypeCode::is_type_fractionable.
All numeric source rows and the Unspecified/invalid-byte false rows execute through FieldTypeCode::is_type_numeric.

Binary utf8mb4_bin utf8mb4_general_ci utf8mb4_unicode_ci and utf8_bin rows execute with the new-collation switch; GBK/GB18030 and utf8mb4_0900 rows remain outside the registered Rust collation domain.
